epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has to judge a dance contest. At first, the decision seems easy but when he discovers that choosing a winner means choosing a loser... It gets complicated! Will he lose the friend he signals out as the loser? How does so much responsibility mak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 季絲在父母外出過夜時,才發現一日不見如隔三秋。/小龍答應蹦士自己跟飛行王牌完成高飛冒險回來時會帶一片雲朵回家。那是若牠能安全歸家的話。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gracie finds out just how long a night and a day can be when her parents are gone on an overnight trip./ Dragon promises to bring Bounce a cloud home when he gets back from his high-flying adventure with the Flying Aces. That’s if he ever gets home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩隻巡演蜻蜓到訪陽光派,小龍突然面對兩難局面:與他深愛的蜘蛛領養家庭待在一起,還是和王牌飛行員一起開始蜻蜓的冒險生活。/小麻和史角將一隻幼小的帝王蝶毛毛蟲帶回家,牠幾乎吃光了牠們的房子,然後當著面變成一隻美麗的蝴蝶。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When two dragonfly barnstormers come to Sunny Patch Dragon is suddenly faced with a tough dilemma./ When Shimmer and Squirt bring home a tiny Monarch Butterfly caterpillar, it almost eats them out of house and home before turning into a beautiful but

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱的無人機測試發現了一個大熊貓的爪印,促使少年遊俠團開展研究熊貓及其小寶寶的任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kais drone test leads to a discovery of a giant panda paw print.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利知悉貘及其寶寶出乎意料地遭老虎狩獵,立即呼召少年遊俠團。老虎的騷擾讓貘寶寶在森林裡迷路。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari calls for the Junior Rangers after learning a Tapir and its child are being hunted.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪發現椰子蟹將椰子從樹頂掉下來,少年遊俠團協助他清理海灘,使它變得更安全。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers assist Kyle in cleaning up the beach and make it safer after discovering a coconut crab.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平靜的早晨被一隻可愛小貓的求助打斷了。法拉呼召少年遊俠團協助牠與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A calm morning is interrupted by a cute kitten, calling the help.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪發現一隻奇怪的受傷動物被鎖在籠裡,就呼召少年遊俠團協助這隻可憐的動物安全回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai discover a strange injured animal locked in a cage and calls on the help of the Junior Ranger.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #15
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利害怕在晚上遇到未知生物,她呼召少年遊俠團助她瞭解更多這種神秘的懸掛動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari calls the Junior Rangers in helping her learning more of the mysterious hanging animal.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #16
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉坐著她的越野電單車穿梭於山林中,從而遇到一隻可憐的臺灣小黑熊。她因擔心而找少年遊俠團協助牠跟媽媽團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Driving her dirt bike on the mountainous forest, Farah encounters a poor moon bear cub.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱的無人機新升級帶領少年遊俠團執行營救雪豹的任務。他們前往尼泊爾山區,在英雄的幫助下拯救雪豹。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kais new drone upgrade leads the Junior Rangers on a mission to rescue a snow leopard.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一條奇怪的魚從水裡蠕動出來。然後她呼召少年遊俠團協助牠回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari discovers a strange fish as it squirming out of the water.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱的煙霧彈實驗讓他遇到一隻日本大鯢。然後他知悉牠被困岩石間,因此他向少年遊俠團尋求幫助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kais smoke bombs experiments lead him to encountering a Giant Japanese Salamander.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠嘉豪在南印度的雨林偶遇一隻會飛的蜥蜴。他請求里奧和姬蒂幫他更瞭解這種獨特的生物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Junior Ranger Kyle stumbles upon a flying lizard in the South Indian rainforest.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #21
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利和少年遊俠團集結,讓一隻可愛小象跟媽媽團聚。小象與遊俠洛奇玩耍過後,遊俠團幫助牠過河。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari and the Junior Rangers unite to reunite an adorable baby elephant with its mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們在沙堆裡發現了一顆牙齒,並想物歸原主/ 水花和朋友們在珊瑚礁競賽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids find a tooth lying in the sand and want to return it / Splash and his friends have a race around the reef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 其他人發現阿燈嘴裡有寄生蟲,都警戒起來/ 阿波聽到一條跨越海洋的奇怪訊息。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The others are alarmed when they find out Dunk has a parasite in his mouth / Ripple hears a strange message traveling through the ocean.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們不相信以前吉殊速度很快/ 阿燈的「小表弟」毛仔到訪,牠是一隻巨大的翻車魚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids don’t believe that Gush used to be very fast / Dunk’s “little cousin” Mo, a giant sunfish, comes to visit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿燈厭倦總是成為「緊張的朋友」/ 水花、阿燈和泡寶跟泰迪一起擔當海帶之森護林員一天。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dunk is tired of always being the “nervous friend” / Splash, Dunk, and Bubbles spend the day with Tidy, as “kelp forest keepers.”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《小毛孩動腦筋》考驗你的動物知識- 一個獨一無二的遊戲節目!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test your animal knowledge on ZooMoos Got Brains -- A game show like no other!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集講述的是動物發出的令人驚嘆的聲音。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the amazing noises that animals make.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物王國中令人毛骨悚然的生物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about creepy creatures from the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了七大洋中最狡猾、最貪婪、最狡猾的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode about the sneakiest greediest cunningest animals that ever sailed the seven seas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於喜歡晚上的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals who like the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物可以聽到甚麼的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about what animals can hear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於奇怪又奇妙的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about weird and wonderful animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於愛好水的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals who love the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛夢想成為真正的超級英雄,所以他們請米娜訓練他們。她恰如其分,只是比路還沒有準備好忍受漫長而艱苦的訓練。他放棄並選擇了一項更容易的活動。那是他以後會後悔的事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo dream of becoming real super heroes so they ask Mina to train them.She sets out to do a great jobbut Bello isnt ready to endure the long and hard training. He gives up and choses an easier activity. Something he will later regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當其他人都得到讚揚和掌聲時,要站著面對並不總是那麼容易。比路嘗試在他朋友的表演中搶盡風頭,讓他們非常沮喪,比路需要分享他的一些才能來解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛發現城堡裡的所有玩具都放在一個盒子裡,他們面對著一項幾乎不可能完成的任務。雖然誘惑很大,但他們接到嚴格的命令,不能碰盒子,因為他們肯定會弄得一團糟。他們能服從命令,讓城堡一塵不染嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello andy Goomo are faced with an almost impossible task when they discover that all the toys in the castle have been placed in a single box. The temptation is great but they have strict orders not to touch the box for they would surely make a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 還有比在音樂誕生的星球更適合跳舞的地方嗎?啫堡上的每個人都會向您展示一段舞蹈,這樣我們就可以隨著啫堡的節奏一起跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成為啫堡之王並非易事。嗯……是容易的。但國王認為應該更容易,所以他創造了自己的複製人,他能指揮他們在四處做所有艱苦的工作。不出所料,這些複製人就像國王一樣非常懶惰,不但沒有提供幫助,反而成為了啫堡一個日益嚴重的新問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡舉行了另一場有趣的比賽,每個孩子必須在渡渡鳥的幫助下,力所能及找到最大的音樂三葉草。比路遇到要協助他的渡渡鳥時感到吃虧。因牠是比路見過最老、最愛發牢騷的渡渡鳥。不過,比路很快就意識到,這隻特殊的渡渡鳥和他們之間的特殊關係,會帶來比他想像中多的驚喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. This Dodo is the oldest and th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王剛剛調整了他的汽車,所以想讓所有人都見到。這就是為何他組織了一場賽車比賽,啫堡上的所有車輛都將參加!甚至連莉塔和她的三輪車也參賽!比賽開始,國王不再自負,這說服孩子們需要聯合起來,全力以赴贏得勝利!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convinc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛的舊運動鞋終於破了,女王送給他一雙閃亮的新鞋。姑毛對新運動鞋那令人著迷的潔白感到非常驚訝,令他做不到任何事。問題是……如果你不能穿著波鞋跑過泥濘或用它們踢球,還要它來幹嘛?姑毛是這麼想的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻變森林」中散步時,發現了一隻離家出走的小渡渡鳥,在這個陌生地方迷了路。在救援行動中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要運用自己的聰敏才能找到小渡渡鳥,並回到朋友身邊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and the Queen take a walk thru the mysterious “changing forest” when they discovera baby Dodo who has strayed away from its parents and is lost in this strange place. During the rescue operation, Rita gets lost as well. She will need to apply he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜的一項實驗刺激到一隻渡渡蝶,使其長得非常巨大。一開始,牠嚇跑了啫堡上所有人,但渡渡蝶和孩子們很快就會經歷一段美好而意想不到的友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Minas experiments provokes a Dodo-Butterfly to grow at mammoth proportions. At the beginning, the animal scares away the people on Jammbo but the Dodo-Butterfly and the children, will soon experience a beautiful and unexpected friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔有很多優點,但卻沒有耐性。這就是為何她無法等到床邊故事時間閱讀女王守衛著的書的下一章。她將與比路合作,瘋狂地搶書,並儘快知道故事的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita has a lot of good qualities but patience is not one of them. Thats why shes incappable of waiting until bedtime to read the next chapter of a book the Queen is guarding. The kid will join forces with Bello in a crazy attempt to get the book, a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜因為莉塔失去了她的房子,所以米娜邀請她的朋友來她家一起住。這種新體驗一開始看起來很有趣,最終卻將成為一個真正的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina losses her house because of Rita, so the little one invites her friend to her house to live with her. This new experience, that seemed so fun at the beginning, will end up being a real challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its become obvious to Queen that the King has become too dependent on the Dodos.A King should be more self-sufficient! So when the Queen expresses her doubts, King is forced to prove that he is, indeed, someone capable of reigning.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是啫堡一個昏暗落雨的下午!孩子們因為不能出去而很難過,所以國王提議一個有趣的活動:輪流講故事。他們將共同創作一個令他們驚喜的故事,甚至將牠們變成……怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路驚訝地聽到國王說施比受更為有福。這怎麼可能?比路竭盡全力證明這一理論。不幸的是,他的嘗試不適用於姑毛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰說你不能一心二用?比路會嘗試證明這是可能的,並會在慶祝生日的同時嘗試照顧國王。他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #9
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎海龜和角馬來到節目。牠們都喜歡旅行——每年都作遠距離大遷徙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Turtle and a Wildebeest to the show. Both of these animals love to travel—migrating great distances each year.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #10
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎鯊魚和海獅來到節目。牠們有共同的棲息地:深藍大海!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a shark and a sea lion to the show. These animals share a habitat: the deep blue sea!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #11
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎犀牛和大猩猩來到節目。本集重點是瀕危物種以及拯救牠們的保育工作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Rhinoceros and a Gorilla to the show. This episode focuses on endangered species and conservation efforts to help save them.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #12
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀基和傑克歡迎海獺和禿鷹來到演出。牠們獨一無二,只因都使用工具來協助生存。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Sea Otter and a Vulture to the show. Both of these animals are unique because they both use tools to help them survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們進行小豬和熊貓搖滾樂隊的試鏡。找出誰將晉級。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children audition for Pig  Pandas Rock Band. Find out who will make the cut.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探險家先生學會製作個人禮物,以感謝曾幫助他的朋友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr Explorer learns to make a personal gift to thank a friend who did him a favour.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利和莫里斯為他們死去的寵物難過。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy and Maurice are sad that their pets have passed away.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們幫助圖騰頭先生解開他丟失的香蕉之謎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children help Mr. Totemhead solve the mystery of his missing bananas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿米爾在沙漠中迷路。小孩們使用一些高科技產品來執行搜索和救援任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Aamil is lost in the Desert. The children use some high-tech gadgets for their search and rescue mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添的視線無法離開遊戲螢幕,令一些可怕的事降臨在他身上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Something awful happens to Tim when he cant take his eyes off his game screen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們驚恐地發現叢林亂作一團!他們一起學習如何愛護自然。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are horrified to find the jungle in a mess! Together, they learn how to care for nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們學習如何使用指南針來找地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children learn how to use a compass to find places.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #22
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉遇到一隻身陷險境的動物!少年遊俠團今次的冒險是幫助法拉與一隻極速海龜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers embark on an adventure to help Farah with a speedy turtle.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #23

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls the Junior Ranger for help in rescuing a trapped whale shark on an Indonesian island.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #24
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在森林裡觀鳥時,發現了一隻被樹枝包圍,做出異常動作獨特的鳥。她向少年遊俠團尋求幫助,並引發誤會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Farah is bird-watching in the forest, she discovers a unique bird with twigs around it.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #25
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利上廁所時意外地遇到一隻貪慕虛榮的孔雀。少年遊俠團決定用一塊鏡子來拯救她。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During an unexpected bathroom break, Zari encounters a vain peacock.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #26

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyle and Junior Rangers help to protect the baby turtles and ensure their safe journey to the ocean.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #27

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kais underwater filming quest leads to a fascinating starfish encounter.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #29
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪划獨木舟時發現了一隻被困在瓶子裡的奇怪動物,於是他請求少年遊俠團幫助送牠回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyle finds a strange animal trapped in a bottle as he was kayaking.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #30

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Zari accidentally catches a clownfish while filling her sandcastle moat.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #31

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farahs dive is interrupted by a sawfish tangled in a fishing line.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #32
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱偶然發現一隻需要幫忙的被困海參,所以少年遊俠團出動!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai stumbles upon a trapped Sea Cucumber in need of help.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #33
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻無助的小食猿鵰不懂如何飛,少年遊俠團要改變此現狀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A helpless baby Philippine Eaglet doesnt know how to fly and its up for the Junior Rangers to change that.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《小毛孩動腦筋》考驗你的動物知識- 一個獨一無二的遊戲節目!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test your animal knowledge on ZooMoos Got Brains -- A game show like no other!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集講述的是動物發出的令人驚嘆的聲音。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the amazing noises that animals make.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物王國中令人毛骨悚然的生物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about creepy creatures from the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了七大洋中最狡猾、最貪婪、最狡猾的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode about the sneakiest greediest cunningest animals that ever sailed the seven seas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於喜歡晚上的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals who like the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物可以聽到甚麼的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about what animals can hear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於奇怪又奇妙的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about weird and wonderful animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於愛好水的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals who love the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是陽光派的母.禮日,蜘蛛小姐的孩子們爭相想給媽媽送上最好的禮物。/一場暴雨打亂了小麻的陽光計劃,差點毀掉了她的一歲生日派對。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When someone eats the bark off of Mr. Mantis’ house and a rumor from Spiderus places Shimmer as the prime suspect, Stinky, Bounce and Squirt set out to clear Shimmer’s name./ Wiggle is afraid of things that go bump in the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人吃掉螳螂先生房子的樹皮,而蛛華士的謠言讓小麻成為頭號疑犯,史汀奇、蹦士和史角開始洗脫小麻的嫌疑,並證明謠言是多麼的刻薄和傷人。/韋高害怕夜裡的怪聲。蜘蛛小姐帶他進行​​「細聽漫步」,助他克服夜間恐懼。

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #22

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers embark on an adventure to help Farah with a speedy turtle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls the Junior Ranger for help in rescuing a trapped whale shark on an Indonesian island.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #24

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Farah is bird-watching in the forest, she discovers a unique bird with twigs around it.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #25

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During an unexpected bathroom break, Zari encounters a vain peacock.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #26

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #27

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利擔驚受怕。小孩們將如何幫助比利克服恐懼?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy cant stop worrying. How will the children help Billy overcome his fears?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幸運符真的能帶來好運嗎?阿添丟失了他的幸運符,小孩們將發現答案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Can a lucky charm really bring good luck? The children find out when Tim loses his lucky charm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鑿奇給阿添戴上他無法摘下的面具,將會發生甚麼事?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when Chalky gives Tim a mask that he cant remove?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 下雨會掃興嗎?小孩們想出了即使下雨也能自得其樂的方法。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Will rain dampen the fun? The children figure out how to keep enjoying themselves even though its raining.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們和探險家先生必須為叢林音樂節而通過一系列舞蹈測試。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children and Mr Explorer have to pass a series of dance tests for Jungle Music Festival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添答應讓其他孩子玩他的新玩具賽車。但為何似乎永遠輪不到他們呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim promises to let the other children play with his new toy race car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鑿奇從寶拉那裡收到一包彩色粉筆。他非常喜歡,一直在用!這卻造成一些麻煩。小孩們必須協助制止鑿奇,以免他的成癮問題讓事情變得更糟。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chalky receives a pack of coloured chalk from Paula. He loves it so much, he cant stop using it!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利害怕黑暗和很多其他事物,他能面對並克服恐懼嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy is scared of the dark and many other things. Will he be able to face his fears and overcome them?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神廟中的一座雕像被偷走,導致叢林發生一些非常不尋常的事情。小孩們能想出將叢林恢復到從前的方法嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A statue is taken from the temple, causing something very unusual to happen to the Jungle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們必須完成貼紙卡,才能贏得神秘獎品。他們很想知道獎品是甚麼,但事實證明收集貼紙比他們想像的要難很多。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children have to complete a sticker card to win a mystery prize.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添有一隻擁有神奇能力的新寵物。小孩們前往叢林跟牠遊玩。這不單很有趣,甚至啟發小孩們想出一個十分有創意的方法,從探險家先生手中拯救圖騰頭先生!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim has a new pet with amazing abilities. The children head to the Jungle to play with it. Its lots of fun and it even inspires the children to come up with a really creative solution to save Mr Totemhead from Mr Explorer!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們前往叢林,通過與他們的叢林朋友散步來幫助阿添習慣他的新靴。不過,他們當中有人跟不上步伐。甚麼能推動他們繼續前進?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children head to the Jungle to help Tim break in his new boots.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謠言在整個遠東村莊傳開,導致友誼破裂。小孩們會怎樣阻止它?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumours are spreading throughout the Far East village and theyre causing friendships to fall apart. What will the children do to put a stop to it?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們迫不及待想知道月餅是甚麼,並與遠東村民一起歡度佳節。不過,頑皮二人組妨礙了快樂的慶典。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are eager to find out what a mooncake is and join in the festivities with the Far East villagers. However a mischievous duo get in the way of the happy celebration.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添想贏得最佳初級攝影師比賽。他有拍攝獲獎照片的技巧嗎?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添想打破蒙著眼接球最多的世界紀錄。找出甚麼或誰在阻止他實現目標。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #40
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱在海灘上遇到一隻擱淺的大型哺乳動物,擔心牠被卡住,他在少年遊俠的幫助下,用姬蒂的新發明安全地把牠帶回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kai bumps into a stranded large mammal by the beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #41
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在澳洲南部森林,嘉豪發現一隻色彩繽紛的孔雀蜘蛛,啟動了一場由少年遊俠展開的混亂救援行動,他們利用彩葉和舞蹈幫助雄蜘蛛求偶,吸引雌蜘蛛注意。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Australian Forest, Kyles discovery of a vibrant Peacock Spider prompts a chaotic rescue mission by the Junior Rangers, as they use colorful leaves and dance to assist the male spider in its courtship, to impress a female spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #42
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞洲濕地,凱用無人機拍攝了令人驚艷的丹頂鶴,卻不慎將無人機撞入鶴巢。里奧、姬蒂和英雄前往救援,試圖不打擾正在繁殖的鶴,取回無人機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the wetlands of Asia, Kai captures stunning footage of Red-Crowned Cranes before crashing his drone into a crane’s nest. Leo, Katie, and Hero embark on a mission to retrieve the drone without disturbing the nesting crane.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #43
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在紐西蘭,嘉豪丟失了他的迴力鏢,卻意外遇到一隻迷路、正在尋找巢穴的黃眼企鵝。他呼叫里奧和姬蒂,幫助企鵝找到家並重回家人懷抱。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, Kyle loses his boomerang but finds a lost Yellow-Eyed Penguin looking for its nest and calls up Leo and Katie to help the penguin find its nest and reunite it with its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #44
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿拉斯加荒野,傑登、里奧、姬蒂和英雄聯手救援被河水沖走的小灰熊,英雄靠著浮力裝置、穿越急流展現搜救實力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Alaskan wilderness, Jayden, Leo, Katie and Hero rescue a grizzly bear cub swept away in a river and Hero tests out his search and rescue skills with his flotation device through strong river currents.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #45

epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a bamboo shark stuck inside a tide pool, the rangers head on a mission to ensure the bamboo shark make its way to the sea, even if it takes a tide pool clean up.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kai bumps into a stranded large mammal by the beach.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, Kyle loses his boomerang but finds a lost Yellow-Eyed Penguin looking for its nest and calls up Leo and Katie to help the penguin find its nest and reunite it with its family.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this tense thriller, a young woman in the South of France kills her masked rapist in self-defense, only to find herself aggressively interrogated and stalked by a mysterious American military investigator.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When heavily armed mercenaries siege the White House, a rejected Secret Service applicant must fight through the lockdown to save the President, rescue his hostage daughter, and prevent World War III.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of Australian commandos launch a secret mission against Japanese forces in World War II to rescue a stranded diplomat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pierce Brosnan stars in Dante’s Peak, where a quiet town faces fiery doom from a reawakening volcano. Explosive action and suspense make this disaster thriller a must-see ride!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the American Civil War, a disgraced Union colonel branded a coward for surrendering his fort without a fight recruits a small band of condemned prisoners to embark on a desperate, bloody suicide mission to take it back from the Confederates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: France, 1640. Cyrano, the charismatic swordsman-poet with the absurd nose, hopelessly loves the beauteous Roxane; she, in turn, confesses to Cyrano her love for the handsome but tongue-tied Christian. The chivalrous Cyrano sets up with Christian an innocent deception, with tragic results.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the world is plunged into eternal darkness, adventurer Xiao Wu sets out to find a sealed ancient book that controls the universe. Betrayed by ruthless factions, he discovers he is a reincarnated magical page bound by an ancient love. Awakening his hidden powers, he battles evil to restore light and fulfil his destiny.

epg.programme_title_tc: R U Tough Enough: Toughness Redefined
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來自亞洲各區的參賽者,在他們踏上R U Tough Enough的背後故事,他們要在final showdown透過體能和毅力脫?而出,最後優勝者可以得到一萬五千元美金和Southeast Asia的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The growing regional competition R U Tough Enough is searching for the toughest person from Southeast Asia. Join the search and meet some of the most mentally and physically strong individuals, leading up to an epic final showdown in Kuala Lumpur for the prize of US$15,000!

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義父慘遭紅花會叛徒殺害,方世玉立誓要追兇復仇。悲痛與忠義驅使下,他毅然挺身對抗陰謀叛黨,掀起一場冷酷無情的正義之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After Fong Sai-Yuk’s adoptive father is murdered by traitors of the Red Flower Society, he vows to hunt them down and avenge his death. Driven by grief and loyalty, he rises against the conspirators in a ruthless fight for justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了對抗溫室效應,女科學家顏欣培育出超級橡膠種子,前往一個荒島進行種植,希望將那裡改變為一片欣欣向榮的新土地。然而,她的前夫決定在這趟危險的旅程中保護她,與她結伴同行。抵達後,他們面臨接連不斷的衝突,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景設定在2050年,世界被污染與瘟疫吞噬的末世。兩名偵探在調查一連串離奇命案時,揭開了一個由邪教組織與致命忍者聯手編織的黑暗陰謀。面對隱藏在迷霧中的強大敵手,他們必須爭分奪秒,在社會徹底崩潰前阻..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來自亞洲各區的參賽者,在他們踏上R U Tough Enough的背後故事,他們要在final showdown透過體能和毅力脫?而出,最後優勝者可以得到一萬五千元美金和Southeast Asia的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The growing regional competition R U Tough Enough is searching for the toughest person from Southeast Asia. Join the search and meet some of the most mentally and physically strong individuals, leading up to an epic final showdown in Kuala Lumpur for the prize of US$15,000!

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義父慘遭紅花會叛徒殺害,方世玉立誓要追兇復仇。悲痛與忠義驅使下,他毅然挺身對抗陰謀叛黨,掀起一場冷酷無情的正義之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After Fong Sai-Yuk’s adoptive father is murdered by traitors of the Red Flower Society, he vows to hunt them down and avenge his death. Driven by grief and loyalty, he rises against the conspirators in a ruthless fight for justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了對抗溫室效應,女科學家顏欣培育出超級橡膠種子,前往一個荒島進行種植,希望將那裡改變為一片欣欣向榮的新土地。然而,她的前夫決定在這趟危險的旅程中保護她,與她結伴同行。抵達後,他們面臨接連不斷的衝突,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景設定在2050年,世界被污染與瘟疫吞噬的末世。兩名偵探在調查一連串離奇命案時,揭開了一個由邪教組織與致命忍者聯手編織的黑暗陰謀。面對隱藏在迷霧中的強大敵手,他們必須爭分奪秒,在社會徹底崩潰前阻..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天山派傳人玉羅剎連下戰書、誅殺四大掌門,震動武林。武當弟子卓一航應戰不敵,反被其美貌傾倒,二人私定終身。未料江湖傳出卓一航將迎娶師妹何綠華,玉羅剎情傷之下,一夜白頭。她大鬧武當,留下「白髮不復青絲,誓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cult leader Yu Luo Sha slays four sect leaders. Zhuo Yi Hang confronts her but falls in love. When he marries another, her hair turns white, and she vows eternal vengeance.

epg.programme_title_tc: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
epg.programme_title_en: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybri
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Gabriella的家人慘死於混血怪物之手。為了復仇,她投身血獵手的行列,毅然踏上獵殺之途。與同伴並肩,向冷血的地下軍權組織宣戰—一場腥風血雨的亡命激鬥就此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gabriella is driven by vengeance after a hybrid monster slaughters her family. On her quest, she joins a squad of Blood Hunters and together they wage war against ruthless underworld warlords, igniting a brutal showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕刺客青面修羅接受人生首份刺殺任務,同時暗中調查當年自己家族滅門慘案幕後起因。但任務還未完成,他發現自己已經捲入了一場策劃多年的陰謀當中,唯有利用自己的刺客技能,一一破局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法蘭克與女友到中東旅行時,女友慘遭殺害,他更被誣陷為兇手入獄。在死牢中結識一名獄友,並在對方暗中協助下策劃越獄,誓要揭開真相,將真正的兇手繩之以法。然而,唯一的盟友卻在行動前夕離奇身亡,法蘭克唯有孤注..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Frank is framed for murder after his girlfriend is killed during a tragic trip to the Middle East. Imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, he befriends a fellow inmate who helps him plot a daring escape to prove his innocence. However, when his only ally suddenly dies, Frank must risk everything to escape and uncover the truth.

Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述清末上海的小人物陳真,在經歷苦難及面對無數挑戰後,蛻變成長為民族英雄的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名兇殺組探員深入密林調查一連串離奇命案,現場遺留的線索竟與流傳已久的「野獸」傳說不謀而合。隨著死亡人數不斷攀升,他們發現這些兇案竟與當地流傳已久的古老傳說有著詭異的關聯,一場潛伏於密林深處的恐怖真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of grisly murders deep in the forest, where disturbing evidence points to the legendary “Beast”. As the body count rises, they uncover a chilling link between the killings and an ancient local legend, while a terrifying truth hidden deep within the woods slowly comes to light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述清末上海的小人物陳真,在經歷苦難及面對無數挑戰後,蛻變成長為民族英雄的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名兇殺組探員深入密林調查一連串離奇命案,現場遺留的線索竟與流傳已久的「野獸」傳說不謀而合。隨著死亡人數不斷攀升,他們發現這些兇案竟與當地流傳已久的古老傳說有著詭異的關聯,一場潛伏於密林深處的恐怖真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of grisly murders deep in the forest, where disturbing evidence points to the legendary “Beast”. As the body count rises, they uncover a chilling link between the killings and an ancient local legend, while a terrifying truth hidden deep within the woods slowly comes to light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港警員阿山以臥底身份潛伏在監獄,接近罪犯天哥,以獲取其犯罪集團的更多證據。二人獲釋後,阿山全力幫助天哥扶搖直上,最終使天哥成為集團的主腦。然而,當阿山協助警方順利摧毀犯罪集團時,他卻意外揭開了天哥的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警探張荼為救落入人販之手的兒子,不惜孤身深入敵穴,跨國追擊,但卻被牽扯進大型兒童拐賣案。在尋找兒子的過程中,他和身份神秘的女子攜手搗毀了一個大型國際犯罪集團,上演了一場驚心動魄的絕地生死營救。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人Burks被一對走投無路的夫婦綁架,被迫踏上開往洛杉磯的亡命之旅。途中危機四伏,三人發現彼此隱藏著致命的秘密。一場原本以為簡單的綁架,卻演變成奪命的博弈,當中沒有人能按計劃全身而退!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kidnapped by a desperate couple, businessman Burks Hill is forced on a frantic journey to Los Angeles. As danger mounts, the three travellers discover that they each harbour deadly secrets. What began as a simple kidnapping spirals into a lethal game where no ones plan will survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金牌保鏢龍威在妻子慘死後患上了創傷後應激障礙,心情低落。他意外結識高科技公司職員Amy,在她邀請下參加了新產品的虛擬測試。龍威測試成功後即成為該公司的虛擬特攻,更獲試用新發明的防護機甲,不料遭遇神秘武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍王被降龍大師封印了五百年,龍王之女為解除父親的封印,不惜穿越時空,回到五百年前殺掉降龍大師。但她沒想到五百年前的龍王與降龍大師竟是生死摯友…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Paul與Robby,一個為了找回生活的掌控權而自願沉淪,一個為了擺脫家庭的財務泥潭而鋌而走險。兩人在毫無規則、拳拳見血的地下非法格鬥場中一路廝殺。最終,在一場血肉橫飛的終極對決裡,兩個傷痕累累的靈魂..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Paul and Robby enter the brutal world of underground no-rules fighting for different reasons; one to regain control of his life, the other to escape his familys financial struggles. As they battle through blood-soaked bouts, their showdown forces two scarred souls to discover the true meaning of victory beyond the fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1917年,少年葉問初到香港求學。英文演講比賽當天,學校發生一宗驚天綁架案,全校同學都被挾持。面對眼前的危機,葉問挺身而出,發現綁匪竟然是自己的師父和好兄弟。少年葉問在危機時刻可否打敗綁匪,從而伸張正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

His lover’s sister, who practises Chinese Kung Fu, initially suspects Neua of being responsible, but later discovers that her sister was killed by an organised crime ring. Together, they join forces to uphold justice and seek vengeance.

The war between human and demon has just begun!

Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三名持槍劫匪搶劫了一批正在運送的新發行貨幣,刑警常勇奉命展開調查。隨著線索逐漸浮現,常勇成功擊斃一名劫匪。然而,其他兩名劫匪不甘就此罷手,乘亂密謀搶劫金廠的黃金。常勇憑藉精密的部署,成功粉碎了他們的計..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘女拳手Koy在泰拳比賽中慘遭擊倒,竟墜入內心深處的恐懼與痛苦之中,並喚醒一片超現實夢境。在一名神秘男子的步步引導下,她必須憑藉傳統古泰拳的千鈞爆發力,隻身對抗層出不窮的幻覺與心魔,挑戰潛藏於內心深..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being defeated in a championship match, Muay Thai fighter Koy awakens in a surreal dreamscape shaped by her fears. Guided by a mysterious man, she must master Korat-style Muay Thai to battle violent illusions and buried trauma. As darkness closes in, Koy fights to reclaim her true identity and survive the ultimate test within her mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gangs conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nations honour.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年鍾馗因家鄉慘遭妖族血洗,痛失至親摯愛。背負血海深仇的他決心下山追凶,卻意外邂逅異變成半妖的刁蠻公主,更揭開昔日戀人詭異「復活」背後的跨界奪權陰謀。面對群妖禍害蒼生,鍾馗手持鎮魔聖劍,一路斬妖除魔,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After demons massacre his hometown and kill his loved ones, young Zhong Kui sets out for revenge. Along the way, he meets a half-demon princess and uncovers a sinister plot behind his former lovers mysterious resurrection. Wielding the Sacred Demon-Slaying Sword, he battles evil and becomes the legendary Demon Queller Zhong Kui.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天才拳擊手徐佳陽為了替父親還賭債在地下酒館打黑拳時被舉報,痛失奧運資格賽,隕落拳壇。十年後,鐵血教練陳麗月決要助她實現父親的遺願,重回拳壇找回昔日的自己。當拳擊的熱血碰上責任時,曾經失落的拳擊夢能否再..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛擺脫前夫家暴陰影的Jas,與妹妹前往英國偏遠鄉村度假散心。不料,兩人在森林散步時遭遇惡棍Randy率領的一群地痞流氓,不僅飽受騷擾與威脅,妹妹更慘遭槍殺。悲憤交加的Jas化身冷血獵手,就地取材設下重..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After escaping her abusive ex-husband, Jas travels with her sister to the remote English countryside for a getaway. During a woodland walk, they encounter Randy and his gang, who harass them before killing her sister. Grief-stricken, Jas sets deadly traps in the storm-soaked forest and embarks on a bloody quest for revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 千年前,青蛇在道清的點化下逐漸開化,生出與道清相守之心。因自己對道清的執念,卻導致道清進入輪迴之劫,遭受世間橫死之難。為了化解道清的劫難,數百年間,青蛇不斷尋找轉世的道清…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前特警隊長東谷在任務中罹患永久性失明,之後更被脅迫要承擔任務失敗的責任。幸好東谷在女兒的陪伴下逐漸走出陰霾,並開始適應黑暗的世界。可是曾經的宿敵再度出現,令女兒陷入危險之中。東谷為救女兒,展開了一場生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義父慘遭紅花會叛徒殺害,方世玉立誓要追兇復仇。悲痛與忠義驅使下,他毅然挺身對抗陰謀叛黨,掀起一場冷酷無情的正義之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After Fong Sai-Yuk’s adoptive father is murdered by traitors of the Red Flower Society, he vows to hunt them down and avenge his death. Driven by grief and loyalty, he rises against the conspirators in a ruthless fight for justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,魔族首領蚩尤擾亂天庭,最終被打回原形,天尊把他貶為凡人,及賜給他仁慈的心。數年後,蚩尤體內的魔性被別有用心的人喚醒,他便前往昆侖尋求解封方法。蚩尤途中結識了火焰山公主葉瀟瀟,二人情愫漸生,而..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 火鍋店在香港深受街坊歡迎,店少東從父親手中接棒經營後卻遇上特殊時期,生意受挫,但少東仍然咬緊牙關,不肯辭退員工,期望生活早日重歸正常。一天,匪徒把火鍋店變成挾持人質的犯罪現場,而員工,顧客及未婚妻生命..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Interpol officer Tie Jia Wen mourns the loss of her lover, and lives incognito as a gym owner with her coaches, Meng Jing, Xi Xi and Dong Ni. However, Tie is troubled by her past when vengeful triad gangs come after her and her coaches. Vowing to uphold justice, Tie decides to fight against the evil gangsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about a ghost hunter, Duan, who is dedicated to maintaining the yin-yang balance and a comic store owner, Yang, who dies in a car accident. Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在辛亥革命軍閥混戰的民國時期,用幻術蠱惑人心的教派林立,以無量老祖為首的教派常用幻術騙局荼毒百姓。這時大家閨秀孫瑾、人狼鏢師黎叔文、及征戰沙場多年的功夫奇才楊烈鈞,三人一起誓要揭露所有幻術的真相。但他..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, many sects use sleazy scams to deceive the public. Young maiden Sun Jin, armed escort Li, and the kung fu expert Yang, join forces to uncover the truth behind the widespread deception. However, they soon discover the hidden secrets of Yang and Li. Who amongst them is the true villain?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神州名將李追風在北坡城被薩滿十萬大軍包圍。為了救出李和一眾將士,黃自在將軍組織了八百人隊伍前往營救,在經過重重險阻後終於救出李將軍,並且為了拖延薩滿士兵而甘願留下來鎮守北坡城,等待李將軍帶援軍趕來。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Huang leads 800 warriors to rescue General Li and other generals trapped by the 100,000 Sha Men troops in Bai Po City. He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements.  In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜,在天水村遇到離奇事件,傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊,現在怨靈回魂伺機索命,流言四起。在調查期間,閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場,不被封建迷信所蒙蔽,努力探尋真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Li believes all demons to be evil until he encounters three events - a fish demon who sacrifices herself for her heartless husband, a pair of lovers who commit suicide for love, and a hedgehog monster who sacrifices himself for his godfather. These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1925, the peaceful Bei Hai City is terrorized by a giant crocodile that devours and kills villagers. A police inspector assigns Hunter Lin Qi and his disciples to catch the crocodile, but they soon discover that there are more than one. Fighting with the crocodiles becomes a test of physical strength, and the good and evil of human nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The demonic cult refines a tree demon to break the seal on a mutated monster. The emperor assigns the head of Demon Sealer Bureau, Tang, to exterminate the tree demon with the skills written on Books of Lu Ban. The mission accidentally unveils Tangs identity as the only survivor from his family massacre and their blood feud against the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

Xiao Yuan seeks help from Song Ci to rescue the scholar and unravels the truth behind Ling Long Towns mystery.

While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

Tang wants to quit for a peaceful life with her husband but is forced to kill the Imperial Prince when the society holds her husband hostage. Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.programme_title_tc: 津沽奇譚1: 暗城殺機
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多年前九龍黑幫頭目章山河因與人火拼而入獄,此時妻子亦因難產而亡,留下女兒。章出獄後,決定放棄黑幫舊業,獨自撫養女兒。然而章為救昔日兄弟,卻導致黑幫老大塔里意外身亡,因此引來塔的弟弟查儂報復,殺死了他的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Zhang was jailed when his wife died after giving birth to their daughter. When Zhang is released, he decides to quit the triad and take care of his daughter but accidentally kills the triad boss. Ta Lis brother, Cha, takes revenge by kidnapping Zhangs daughter, resulting in a deadly battle between the two men.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dreaming of becoming a legendary swordsman, young Yu Dayou is drawn into a deadly conflict over a mythical sword and uncovers a conspiracy between coastal pirates and foreign invaders. After losing his master and comrades, he rises through hardship to defend his nation, avenge his master, and fulfil his heroic destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來世界,人工智慧高速發展,由程非掌控的地下科研組織,為牟取暴利研製激發異能人的晶片。由於一次變故,程下令清除所有實驗者,導致千鶴母親犧牲,而逃出生天的千鶴為替母親報仇,以身涉險對抗惡勢力,在危急關頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.programme_title_en: Fengshen the Fall of King Zhou
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女媧諸神啟動“封神計畫顛覆商朝統治,安排了九尾妖狐上身妲己前來迷惑紂王。而紂王日漸傾心妲己對她專寵無度,更不服神旨逆天而行,建摘星樓登天問道與神對抗,並受申公豹挑唆殘害忠良,百姓苦不堪言。姜子牙助四..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set by Goddess Nu Wa to overthrow the Shang dynasty, Consort Da Ji is possessed by the Demon Fox to bewitch Emperor Zhou. Zhou spoils Da Ji by building a tower to heaven against Gods will, and even oppresses his people. Jiang Zi Ya steps up to help fight the Emperor, starting a war between the humans, the gods and the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一列載著淘金夢開往上海的列車突然脫軌墜崖。吳天等一行人倖免於難,卻遭到蜈蚣攻擊。隨後他們逃進了一個怪異村莊,而古怪的村長對這幫各懷鬼胎的倖存者起了殺心。突然成群蜈蚣傾巢而出,在村中大開殺戒。吳天等..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A train carrying gold rushers derails and falls off the cliff. Wu and other passengers survive, but are attacked by centipedes. Subsequently, they escape to a village. With the village head trying to kill them and the centipedes attacking at the same time, can Wu and other passengers escape the disaster? What is the secret of the village head?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛世大唐氣象萬千,各色人物皆在江湖中行走,身懷絕技的盲眼“捉刀人成瞎子,遇上慘遭滅門和淩辱的酒家女倪燕。原本不與人有過多交情的成瞎子卻意外與她產生關聯,亦逐漸被捲入一場勢力龐大的暗黑紛爭中。成瞎子開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 城裡驚現“僵屍病毒,人心惶惶,民不聊生。茅山弟子雲淩與三位師兄弟奉命下山盡辦法解救百姓於水火,不料四人卻步入幕後黑手的陷阱,被幻蠱術迷惑,挑撥四人之間的兄弟情。及後城中更有一只壯如怪獸的食人鬼蛛入侵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a town ravaged by the vampire virus, four Maoshan disciples including Yun Ling are tasked with finding the cure. However, they are entrapped by the schemes of the mastermind, which caused discord amongst them. When the town is besieged by a spider demon, the four disciples have to overcome their conflicts and unite to save the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝末年,大明水師軍官林嘯為了阻止東瀛倭寇得到“神機武庫,及要找回失蹤的戰友陸老大,而接受了水師參將向吉的徵召,踏上兇險的尋寶之路。航行中,神秘海怪族羣與倭寇均同時盯上了林的船。他必須與同伴合力與倭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To stop the Japanese pirates and find his missing friend, the Ming dynasty Marine Officer Lin Xiao joins the Marine General to embark on a treasure hunt. On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港警隊與黑勢力誓不兩立,一個以程志飛為隊長的“反飛車組組成反飆車隊,另一個以蔣小海為首的“飛車黨是一群黑市非法街頭飆車黨。因為一局地下飆車賽,警方在調查過程中顯露了程與蔣長達十五年的恩怨,更揭開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Police and the triads are irreconcilable opponents. Inspector Cheng leads the anti street car racing team and Jiang is the leader of the street car racing gang. While the police investigates an underground street car race, they uncover the 15-year grudge between Cheng and Jiang, and discover a hidden triad group.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀山太保傳人張三爺應師弟赫老道之邀,與徒弟前往棺山找尋傳說中的麻姑墓。相傳內裡不僅有珍貴寶物,還有長生之術。他們為探尋真相去尋找古墓,而當古墓即將開啟時,軍閥羅蠻子突然出現。原來這是一個騙局,羅及赫是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Sanye joins his junior He Lao Dao on a quest to a fabled tomb said to hold treasures and the secrets of immortality. However, as the tomb is about to open, warlord Luo Man Zi suddenly appears, and it turns out to be a plot set up by both Luo and He for Zhang. A thrilling journey into the tomb has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Di Ren Jie is assigned by Empress Wu to investigate the massacre of Minister Hus family. In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺,激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中,之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是,四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前海外某安保公司的精英隊員韓彬,在一次保護任務時失敗,從此銷聲匿跡,頹廢終日。老拍檔希望韓能重新振作,在他極力邀請下,韓答應保護明星蘇曉琪前往東南亞某國拍攝節目。一路上,韓化解了多次威脅曉琪生命安全的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Former elite security guard Han Bin vanishes after a failed escort mission and wallows in self pity. His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高尚是一名普通的救護車司機,從小就懷抱著賽車夢想。他誤打誤撞捲入一場飆車糾紛中,結識了一流賽車機械師鮑佳音,令他有機會開啓賽車手之路。在他猶疑不知應該選擇安穩生活還是賽車夢想之際,好友的萌萌激勵讓他領..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao, an ambulance driver, aspires to be a car racer. He meets top race car engineer Bao during a car racing dispute, which sets him on a path towards his dream. Gao faces the dilemma of leading a stable life or pursuing his passion, but finally decides to embrace his dream and live life to the fullest with the support of his close friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,觀山太保傳人封四九為了幫助籌募軍餉,答應鄭大帥嫡子鄭東西請求,尋找死在千季古地宮“九館裡的遺體。鄭其實想找尋寶物,同時又找了發丘中郎一族後代陳青山一同參與。眾人幾番陷入兇險,幸好陳與封互相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To raise funds for their troops, Master Feng agress to help Zheng Dong Xi find corpses within an ancient tomb. Zhengs true motive is to uncover the tombs hidden treasure and he also enlist the help of Chen. Together, they embark on a perilous expedition to hunt for the treasure as well as to help the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
