It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝末年,一個名為修羅幕主的神秘組織聲稱擁有武林至寶八極玄盒。他們邀請了頂尖的武林高手參加武林大會,事實上想用秘製毒藥控制他們為組織效力。太極宗師張三豐為要揭露組織的陰謀參加了武林大會,最終解開了八極..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 首屈一指的馴鳥師茅山豪,在鳳凰島遭遇變異物種襲擊,並不斷有人離奇失蹤,人心惶惶。為了探尋真相,豪與治安隊隊長孟前冰釋前嫌,並通力合作調查此失蹤案。可怕的是,線索竟指向與僵屍有關!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a  security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中,特種兵王周揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動,卻遭遇戰友慘死,此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時,兩人決定再度聯手,共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 墨家機關術嫡系傳人沈拓接受無極監獄典獄長的邀請,與六名隊友進入機關城最底部,尋找墨家磁石,打開監獄機關。但墨家機關在城內佈局千變萬化,傳言至今從未有人能夠活著出來。沈拓為了救出妻子姜刃,及讓監獄里的人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shen Tuo, a descendant of Mohist Mechanism, is invited by the prison chief to find a magnet in the prison basement with a team of six. However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the citys labyrinth of mechanism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青山大學著名植物學教授霍玉春研發出一種可以讓植物與動物DNA相結合的新病毒。此時女學生羅柯向教授的助教鄭問表白,兩人墜入愛河之際,病毒突然在學校中爆發,柯不幸受感染被隔離。為了拯救學校及柯,鄭問找到教..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

epg.programme_title_en: The Legend and Hag of Shaolin
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清康熙年間,少林弟子洪熙官為完成師父蔡九儀遺志,與師弟方世玉前往廣州發揚少林武學。洪熙觀在與吳三桂勢力,朝廷勢力,廣東拳師等不同的人交手過程中,逐漸將戚家軍功夫、少林功夫、和明末廣東地方拳術融為一體,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shaolin disciple Hong Xi Guan travels to Guangzhou with Fang Shi Yu to propagate Shaolin martial arts. Through exchanges with rival sect masters and imperial forces, Hong integrates Shaolin martial arts skills into other martial arts styles and established the Hung Sect, which embodied the collective wisdom and beauty of the martial arts world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新娘元如意在洞房花燭夜全家被殺,自己被一蒙面人救出。一年後,如意在消息販子包大庭口中得知,父親為救百姓當年殺死了一個賊寇,賊寇之子鐵背駝爺為報父仇血洗元家。在包的幫助下,如意尋找敵人的弱點,一個個剷除..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bride named Ru is the sole survivor of her familys massacre, and is rescued by a masked man. A year later, she learns from the newsmonger Bao that the massacre was orchestrated by a bandit who wants to avenges his fathers death caused by Rus father. With the help of Bao, Ru vanquishes the lackeys of the bandit and seeks her own vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,因人類的貪念欲望所生成的魔王阿爾薩召集亡靈軍團征服了世界,而上古人類領袖以鮮血鑄成聖劍封印了阿爾薩。千百年後,阿爾薩破開封印,開始在東原大陸發起進攻。此時聖殿騎士團聯合東方巡夜山宮等武林門派..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In ancient times, Demon King Artha summons the dead spirit army to conquer the world, but is sealed by the holy sword. Thousand years later, Artha breaks the seal and launches an attack to the east. The holy chevaliers unite with the martial arts cults to find the holy sword, hoping to seal Artha again and save the people from his tyrannical reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.programme_title_tc: 伏妖開封府之御貓展昭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北宋時期,宦官專權,邪靈橫行,汴梁境內興起了許多邪教,其中最大勢力是“外九流。開封府裡的包拯、展昭和公孫策秘密審理邪靈案,然而“外九流的人試圖毒害包拯,還籌劃著更龐大的陰謀。面對此情況,開封府眾人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuchs are powerful in the Northern Song Dynasty as evil religion sects emerge, with the largest one being “Wai Jiu Liu”. As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,一代奇人關師爺行走江湖,巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法,過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後,關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨,為死去的冤者伸冤,卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著用生命來維護世間陰陽平衡的陽冥司端木熙,與遭遇車禍意外死去的漫畫屋老闆楊敬華。楊陰差陽錯被迫與端簽訂終身契約,成為端的影靈,二人互相看不慣對方,卻被契約緊緊捆綁在一起。之後連續發生詭異的死亡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about a ghost hunter, Duan, who is dedicated to maintaining the yin-yang balance and a comic store owner, Yang, who dies in a car accident. Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴,邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務,為了掩護隊友撤退,美獨自引爆炸彈,與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架,迫雅美..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號,為探尋外星文明,艦長“原帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號駛向宇宙,但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後,深空號突然出現,船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹。在她..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天意是天界出名的留級生,因前世孽緣未了無法成仙,後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡,在捉拿雪女過程中,天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯,天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年,一番磨難後,二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在剿滅東南亞最大的犯罪組織救世會時,金泰在任務中誤殺了自己的師傅金銘。泰極度自責,默然離開特工組織。然而消失多年的救世會再次出現,泰更得知組織的頭目竟是死而復生的銘,令他一蹶不振,直到一個男孩的出現,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secret agent Tai accidentally kills his master Ming, as he tries to destroy a powerful criminal gang. Tai is so guilty that he decides to leave the agency, but the gang with Master Ming as its head, reappear years later. Devastated by his masters deception, Tai returns as an agent to settle their grudges after being inspired by a young man.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大荒城城主張塢為復活三千年前被皇帝打敗而封印於東海某處的赤睺,到處蠱惑人心,並指使各種妖怪在人間胡作非為。少年李靖學成下山後見此情景,堅信心中正義一路斬妖除魔,並與路途中遇到的薑子牙等人結為隊友,各顯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 火鍋店在香港深受街坊歡迎,店少東從父親手中接棒經營後卻遇上特殊時期,生意受挫,但少東仍然咬緊牙關,不肯辭退員工,期望生活早日重歸正常。一天,匪徒把火鍋店變成挾持人質的犯罪現場,而員工,顧客及未婚妻生命..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十世紀90年代末的哈爾濱,于鐵在替人收債時,對借貸人的女兒金佳麗一見鍾情。鐵雖然是收債人,但他為人講義氣、心地善良及認真對待感情的態度,終於打動了麗。可惜鐵突如其來的頭痛,加上與收債組織的大哥在處事..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the late 90s in Harbin, Tie falls for Li while collecting debts from her father. Li is touched by Ties loyalty, kindness and desire for true love. Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十世紀90年代末的哈爾濱,于鐵在替人收債時,對借貸人的女兒金佳麗一見鍾情。鐵雖然是收債人,但他為人講義氣、心地善良及認真對待感情的態度,終於打動了麗。可惜鐵突如其來的頭痛,加上與收債組織的大哥在處事..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the late 90s in Harbin, Tie falls for Li while collecting debts from her father. Li is touched by Ties loyalty, kindness and desire for true love. Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神州名將李追風在北坡城被薩滿十萬大軍包圍。為了救出李和一眾將士,黃自在將軍組織了八百人隊伍前往營救,在經過重重險阻後終於救出李將軍,並且為了拖延薩滿士兵而甘願留下來鎮守北坡城,等待李將軍帶援軍趕來。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Huang leads 800 warriors to rescue General Li and other generals trapped by the 100,000 Sha Men troops in Bai Po City. He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements.  In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世,卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹,被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用,得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血,顛覆人類,以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀,在危急關..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東漢末年亂世紛爭,少年趙子龍與同鄉夏侯蘭因為一場意外而捲入到這個亂世中來,但他們二人卻選擇了不同的人生道路。最終趙子龍戰勝了為一己之私而背叛初衷的夏侯蘭。趙持長劍於亂世行走,踏破黑暗掀起波瀾,最終選擇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Eastern Han Dynasty, young Zhao Zi Long and his comrade Xia Hou Lan accidentally get involved in the chaos, but they end up with different paths in life. Zhao Zi Long finally triumphs over the selfish Xia Hou Lan and fights against the dark forces, teaming up with Liu Bei and achieving victories for the Han dynasty in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林大會時,盟主霍長空與血魔羅決戰時輸了,血魔亦元氣大傷,危急關頭霍將功力注入劉晶體內,劉意外獲得內力。十四年後,劉在隅然機會下來到“霍家拳館,陰差陽錯遇到血魔羅重出江湖找霍家人報仇。有著霍長空功力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated by Blood Demon in a martial arts tournament, Master Huo passes his skills to young Liu Jing. Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地球未來,人類大量排放廢氣製造垃圾,使到地球迎來沙化期。動植物變異產生地球新主人“沙蟲,而它們將人類逼到滅絕邊緣,倖存者只能尋找僅存的避難所“綠洲。一支由富商、科學家、保安隊長、機械師以及混混組..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In future earth, humans emit exhaust gas to produce waste, leading to earths desertification. Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天時期,京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件,因為死因不明,以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈,百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥,人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案,最終不僅破除了謠言,也通..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.programme_title_tc: 追龍番外篇之龍爭虎鬥
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 徐樂加入警界本想匡扶正義,卻發現整個警界都腐敗不堪。在前輩指點下,他決定力爭上遊,成為最有勢力的探長,改善貪污。此時徐樂的好兄弟伍國豪的黑道勢力日漸壯大,徐樂深知無法勸阻阿豪收手,無奈之下與廉政公署聯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Xu Le joins the police force with a strong desire for justice. Noting the serious corruption in the force, Xu seeks to become the most powerful inspector to eradicate corruption. Though his friend heads a triad gang, Xu still joins forces with the ICAC to provide evidence against the culprits to make them pay the price of their crimes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉,本打算過平常人的生活,但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據,方世玉雖面對好友周蓉的慘死,母親被擒為人質,但卻面無懼色,決意反抗到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在幫派紛爭中銷聲匿跡的龍頭阿暿向來獨來獨往,武功了得,更是霍氏醉拳的高手。阿暿隱姓埋名化身為懲治惡勢力的俠客。而行事殘暴的軍閥霄霸天與黑虎山山匪勾結,成立壓榨當地貧民的茶廠 來幫他們種植鴉片。阿暿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cult leader Ah Xi is a top martial artist who is also a skilled Huo Drunken Fist fighter. However, she chooses to become an incognito swordswoman who fights against evil. Warlord Xiao Ba Tin colludes with some bandits and force the poor to plant opium. Ah Xi steps up to fight against them and finally exterminate the evil gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大宋淳佑七年,欽州靈龍鎮災患頻現,民間謠言乃蛟龍作祟,需將童男童女投入鎖龍井餵食蛟龍方能得享安寧,無數鎮民的子孫被投入井中。新科進士莊嚴擔任主簿後,執意要進入鎖龍井調查,卻因為誣捏他得罪龍王而被囚禁入..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ling Long Town faces frequent natural disasters. Rumour has it that feeding the dragon in the well with children will help. A new imperial scholar wants to investigate the well but is imprisoned for allegedly offending the Dragon Emperor. Xiao Yuan seeks help from Song Ci to rescue the scholar and unravels the truth behind Ling Long Towns mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一列載著淘金夢開往上海的列車突然脫軌墜崖。吳天等一行人倖免於難,卻遭到蜈蚣攻擊。隨後他們逃進了一個怪異村莊,而古怪的村長對這幫各懷鬼胎的倖存者起了殺心。突然成群蜈蚣傾巢而出,在村中大開殺戒。吳天等..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A train carrying gold rushers derails and falls off the cliff. Wu and other passengers survive, but are attacked by centipedes. Subsequently, they escape to a village. With the village head trying to kill them and the centipedes attacking at the same time, can Wu and other passengers escape the disaster? What is the secret of the village head?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..

Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dreaming of becoming a legendary swordsman, young Yu Dayou is drawn into a deadly conflict over a mythical sword and uncovers a conspiracy between coastal pirates and foreign invaders. After losing his master and comrades, he rises through hardship to defend his nation, avenge his master, and fulfil his heroic destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1928年的上海灘,新生勢力龍德商會為擴大地盤與老牌勢力通明堂產生利益衝突,雙方摩擦不斷。通明堂小少爺周放,因父親被殺要為父報仇,帶領眾人對決龍德商會,卻在復仇過程中與商會二把手林海惺惺相惜。然而二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1928 Shanghai, a new triad gang plans to expand their territory, causing conflicts with the old triad gang. As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百年前,玉須仙師封印變種異獸於八州。大趙王朝四十年,往生邪教顧念彤煉祭樹妖破壞封印,皇上命封魔局主管唐淩風前往滅妖,而其中需要《魯班全書》中的秘術來擊敗樹妖。而數十年前公輸家為得到魯班全書將唐氏滅門,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The demonic cult refines a tree demon to break the seal on a mutated monster. The emperor assigns the head of Demon Sealer Bureau, Tang, to exterminate the tree demon with the skills written on Books of Lu Ban. The mission accidentally unveils Tangs identity as the only survivor from his family massacre and their blood feud against the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 城裡驚現“僵屍病毒,人心惶惶,民不聊生。茅山弟子雲淩與三位師兄弟奉命下山盡辦法解救百姓於水火,不料四人卻步入幕後黑手的陷阱,被幻蠱術迷惑,挑撥四人之間的兄弟情。及後城中更有一只壯如怪獸的食人鬼蛛入侵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a town ravaged by the vampire virus, four Maoshan disciples including Yun Ling are tasked with finding the cure. However, they are entrapped by the schemes of the mastermind, which caused discord amongst them. When the town is besieged by a spider demon, the four disciples have to overcome their conflicts and unite to save the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frogs eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 甲蟲已經在地球上居住了超過2.4億年.科學家們已知的甲蟲大約有38萬種,而每年都會發現數百種新品種.世上四分之一的動物是甲蟲.牠們幾乎征服了地球上每個角落和棲息地,在每次全球災難中都能倖存下來.牠們為何如此成功?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquer...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣.看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物.瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive under Mexicos Yucatán rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞拉利昂戈達位於墨西哥中部的中心地帶,是一個由許多生態組成的地區.從海拔300至3000米拔地而起,從古老的半沙漠化低山開始,進入一片茂密的綠色雲霧森林,當中棲息著山貓,美洲獅和飛鼠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物.一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引.但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈.莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the worlds largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defe...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive under Mexicos Yucatán rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞拉利昂戈達位於墨西哥中部的中心地帶,是一個由許多生態組成的地區.從海拔300至3000米拔地而起,從古老的半沙漠化低山開始,進入一片茂密的綠色雲霧森林,當中棲息著山貓,美洲獅和飛鼠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive under Mexicos Yucatán rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊.但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界.雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要.在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力.有時生存只能依靠超能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕.冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配.一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒.大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子.三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季.跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋佔據地球的70%,是多達一百萬種已知動植物的家園.但鞏固全球最大食物網的卻是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物.這些微生物漂流在海洋的眾多棲息地,所到之處就會觸發覓食週期.沒有牠們,海洋中的生命將不復存在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ocean sprawls across 70 percent of our planet and is home to as many as one million known species of plants and animals. However, it is the smallest of ocean creatures that underpins the worlds largest food web – plankton. These microscopic o...

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同踏入樹林與水源共同孕育新生命的溼地,再潛入保護年幼海狗的水下森林,拜訪一群藏身在紅樹林保護區的好奇水下古怪生物,同時你還有機會一窺真實存在的沼澤怪物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕.冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配.一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒.大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子.三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季.跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋佔據地球的70%,是多達一百萬種已知動植物的家園.但鞏固全球最大食物網的卻是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物.這些微生物漂流在海洋的眾多棲息地,所到之處就會觸發覓食週期.沒有牠們,海洋中的生命將不復存在.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現代動物始祖演化出的第一個感官是化學感官:牠們能夠檢測環境中的化學物質.這有助動物始祖尋找獵物和配偶,並從遠處感知逐漸靠近的捕食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animals environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大埃克蘇馬是一個偏遠的奇觀:數百個小島從巴哈馬首都拿騷向南延伸.在50年代,開發商夢想開發這個原始,未被探索的地區.但在建設開始之前,巴哈馬政府於區內發起了一次考察.他們喜歡所看到的事物,並於1959年建立了巴哈馬國家信託基金,創建了巴哈馬的第一個海洋公園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Exuma Cays are a remote wonder: hundreds of tiny islands extending south from the Bahamian Capital of Nassau. In the 1950s, developers dreamed of developing this pristine, and largely unexplored region. But before construction could begin, th...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加有近400種爬行動物,約佔世界冷血動物的一半.觀看變色龍,蛇和300多種五顏六色的青蛙在島上的極端氣候中茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lives of Madagascars cold-blooded creatures. Chameleons, frog, lizards, and snakes have all adapted in order to survive on the island. We take a look at how they find food, reproduce, and avoid predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與美洲虎幼崽弗里達一起探索極限,她正在巴西的凱門保護區磨練自己的生存技能.學習如何與媽媽加圖納一起潛行,看姐姐阿努克幫助她躲避飢餓的入侵者,最後進行一次冒險但幸運的單獨跋涉,.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, whos honing her survival skills in Brazils Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看海獅蘿拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性戰場上邁出的第一步.觀察這個海獅寶寶學會了關鍵的發聲和游泳技能,努力留在媽媽瑪麗亞身邊並以迅雷不及掩耳之勢躲過致命捕獵,為她歡呼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南方的絨毛蛛猴朵拉邁出了離開媽媽咪咪的第一步,跟著牠一起領略巴西大西洋沿岸森林的魅力吧.學習蛛猴群的動作技巧,學習掛尾技術,並看看這個小傢伙在同齡人中找到自己的位置.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the enchantment of Brazils Atlantic Forest as southern muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from mum Mimi. Get lessons in spider monkey troop dynamics, bone up on tail-hanging technique, and see this baby find her place among her peers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與勇敢的浣熊小貓蒂亞戈一起踏上冒險之旅.看看這個像浣熊一樣的小傢伙如何磨練自己的嗅覺與覓食技能,穿過鬱鬱蔥蔥的巴西森林家園附近的郊區公路,同時躲避被汽車撞到的危險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set a course for adventure with Thiago, a brave baby coati. Find out how this raccoon-like fellow sharpens his sniffing and foraging skills, crosses suburban roads near his lush Brazilian forest home, and avoids inanimate and four-legged dangers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西美麗的潘塔納爾濕地,參觀巨型水獺的最後一個棲息地.跟隨幼崽里奧和牠的兄弟姐妹,看他們如何試水,如何聯手躲避美洲虎的伏擊,並成為一個有凝聚力的家庭單位,共同狩獵並繁衍生息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit the last stronghold of the giant river otter in Brazils beautiful Pantanal wetland. Track pup Rio and his siblings as they test the waters, team up to evade a jaguar ambush, and become a cohesive family unit that hunts and thrives together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴過得動盪不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨後的短暫大餐,因為隨之而來又是乾燥日子.隨著牠們的幼崽長大,覓食的壓力變得比之前更大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wild Coast of South Africa stretches for 170 miles. Here, the waters of the Indian and the Atlantic converge, forcing powerful waves towards the shoreline. This is where the Mozambique-based manta ray researcher Andrea Marshall hopes to conduc...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物.一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引.但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈.莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the worlds largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defe...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊.但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界.雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要.在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋佔據地球的70%,是多達一百萬種已知動植物的家園.但鞏固全球最大食物網的卻是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物.這些微生物漂流在海洋的眾多棲息地,所到之處就會觸發覓食週期.沒有牠們,海洋中的生命將不復存在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ocean sprawls across 70 percent of our planet and is home to as many as one million known species of plants and animals. However, it is the smallest of ocean creatures that underpins the worlds largest food web – plankton. These microscopic o...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 到非洲窺探野生動物終生不懈的尋找水源之旅.見證地球上最壯觀的海洋覓食狂潮,了解眼鏡蛇的太陽能儲備,並跟隨牛羚與大象家族踏上壯闊的遷徙之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africas wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熟悉各種海洋怪咖,從冰河時期到小行星撞擊,瞭解數十億年來的變化,如何塑造牠們的外表和技能.認識會釣魚的蛇蜥,跑行的鯊魚,爬樹的螃蟹等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 感受地球上一些最奇特的怪胎伙伴關係中古怪而溫馨的愛.深入觀察奇怪的動物,從鼓蝦到鰻狼魚,向牠們的海洋怪人朋友伸出援手,以確保能一起生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the love in the strange-but-heartwarming partnerships between some of Earths oddest creatures. Dive deep to see strange animals, from snapping shrimp to wolf eels, offer a hand to their fellow ocean-going weirdos to ensure mutual survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 引導你骨子裡的科幻迷,探索海洋中最奇特生物的奇異交配儀式.瞭解為交配而戰,性別偏移和一班加大碼嬰兒為了下一代能有多血腥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the oceans most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 到非洲窺探野生動物終生不懈的尋找水源之旅.見證地球上最壯觀的海洋覓食狂潮,了解眼鏡蛇的太陽能儲備,並跟隨牛羚與大象家族踏上壯闊的遷徙之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africas wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the oceans most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觸覺能讓物種感知各種物理力量所帶的感覺,包括得知咬傷,感受溫度變化和不同質地.一些動物對非常微弱的振動特別敏感,牠們能從中獲得大量關於環境的訊息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片觀察德拉肯斯堡山脈上野生動物的生態.我們會看到生物如何在頂峰到山下起伏的草原等無情的地貌中生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary looks at the wildlife of The Drakensberg Mountain range. We take a look at how creatures survive in the hostile landscape, from the highest peaks to the rolling grasslands below.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞拉國家公園中陰暗的森林,對行縱隱密的豹來說是完美的藏身之所;而年輕的䧳豹阿莎亦準備好獨自闖蕩.一起見證她爭奪自己的領地,尋找伴侶,到成為母親的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. Its time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞洲最大的象群每年都會齊集於米內瑞亞國家公園舉行盛會;而在本年的周年大會上,於這片神聖的地方,小象洛卡誕生了!一起見證他在大象的混戰中學習進食,游泳和使用他的象鼻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯里蘭卡的低地遍布著數千個看似平靜的湖泊,但「湖」不可貌相,湖水中盡是沼澤鱷的天下.沼澤鱷生來就是獵人,一起來看看這些頂尖獵食者在炙熱的環境中如何互相競爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sri Lankas lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but dont be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群.跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點.走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the islands forests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家.這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性. 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探小熊們在夏季如何學習爬樹和覓食,為重返野外生活做好準備.迎接一批新成員驚喜入營,見證熊寶貝們進入冬眠前的大吃特吃,並享受一場盛大的小熊感恩祭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨羅傑為夏季小熊的野放做好準備,然後一起認識兩位新來的小熊--艾斯和小藍莓;牠們因嚴重的健康問題,必須在營中暫住,與新一批小熊們一起過冬.最後,一同慶祝六隻健康快樂的熊寶貝踏上全新的野外生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視野對生存尤關重要.這是百分之九十五的動物瞭解世界的方法.眼睛是如此重要,從難以置信地簡單到令人費解地複雜,它們已經獨立地進化了近百次.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vision – its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力.有時生存只能依靠超能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證棲身於西海岸的不同物種,如何忍受嚴冬並迎接初春的來臨.親眼目睹在強風下的紅鹿激戰,在風聲呼嘯的暴風雨中歡迎海豹寶寶來臨,以及象鯊群的回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪世界著名的斯凱利群島,穿梭令人眼花繚亂的峭壁,並探索一座有1500年歷史的修道院.拜訪棲身曼島的薙鳥和座頭鯨,然後在克萊爾追逐矮小的鼩鼱.最後來到阿蘭群島,一睹秋季的壯觀景象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​發現歐洲最佳建築如何為一些大陸上最稀有的物種創造庇護所.前往法國,蘇格蘭和西班牙,在那裡,海豹,鳥類,蠑螈,野貓和蛇類在水邊的古老地標之間茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how Europes best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continents rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在歐洲最壯觀的山峰之中見證動物的戲劇.造訪羅馬尼亞和法國的中世紀城堡,那裡的熊,猞猁和獵鷹正在復甦,然後看看在比利牛斯山中巧妙適應氣候變化的岩蜥蜴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness animal drama among Europes most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard thats cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視覺是最令人驚嘆的感官,為物種帶來無窮的適應能力.不同動物的眼睛賦予牠們截然不同的視覺,在某些情況下甚至讓人「眼界大開」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 到非洲窺探野生動物終生不懈的尋找水源之旅.見證地球上最壯觀的海洋覓食狂潮,了解眼鏡蛇的太陽能儲備,並跟隨牛羚與大象家族踏上壯闊的遷徙之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africas wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上.看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba prides nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 母獅們出發尋找正在獵捕水牛的雄獅,為此她們必須穿越鱷魚出沒的河流.跟隨姆萬巴獅群中唯一的幼獅米洛,見證他如何在脫離險境,並成為延續家族未來的希望.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有的運動都會產生聲波;有些物種成功演化出器官來檢測空氣或水中的聲波,以感知環境中的運動.齊來暸解這些動物的敏銳聽覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sound waves are produced by movement. Animals have evolved organs to detect those sound waves in the air or water to perceive movements in their environment. These are some of the animals that have mastered the sense of hearing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上.看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as hes saved from snapping jaws and cements the familys future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉伯的珊瑚礁是大自然中最厲害的幻術師故鄉.生物可以隨著脈動變色,眨眼間就能變形,也能進行引人入勝的表演.因為在這片危險的水域,偽裝很重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arabias coral reefs are home to some of natures most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿曼海岸附近,夏季天氣在海洋深處與阿拉伯陽光的交匯處驅生養分,從而迸發生命.產下較小的魚,水中充滿魚卵.這成了肉食性動物無法抗拒的自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just cant resist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折.與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koalas spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelles slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陡峭的山脈和熱帶季風塑造了湄公河流域的地貌,並一直延伸至老撾.一起探索這個豐富的生態系統,拜訪短尾獮猴,斑頂翡翠和黑冠長臂,並見證他們如何在這片福地上找到棲身之所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness animal drama among Europes most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard thats cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉伯的珊瑚礁是大自然中最厲害的幻術師故鄉.生物可以隨著脈動變色,眨眼間就能變形,也能進行引人入勝的表演.因為在這片危險的水域,偽裝很重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arabias coral reefs are home to some of natures most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿曼海岸附近,夏季天氣在海洋深處與阿拉伯陽光的交匯處驅生養分,從而迸發生命.產下較小的魚,水中充滿魚卵.這成了肉食性動物無法抗拒的自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just cant resist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折.與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koalas spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelles slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陡峭的山脈和熱帶季風塑造了湄公河流域的地貌,並一直延伸至老撾.一起探索這個豐富的生態系統,拜訪短尾獮猴,斑頂翡翠和黑冠長臂,並見證他們如何在這片福地上找到棲身之所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上.看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba prides nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 母獅們出發尋找正在獵捕水牛的雄獅,為此她們必須穿越鱷魚出沒的河流.跟隨姆萬巴獅群中唯一的幼獅米洛,見證他如何在脫離險境,並成為延續家族未來的希望.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在歐洲最壯觀的山峰之中見證動物的戲劇.造訪羅馬尼亞和法國的中世紀城堡,那裡的熊,猞猁和獵鷹正在復甦,然後看看在比利牛斯山中巧妙適應氣候變化的岩蜥蜴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness animal drama among Europes most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard thats cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熟悉各種海洋怪咖,從冰河時期到小行星撞擊,瞭解數十億年來的變化,如何塑造牠們的外表和技能.認識會釣魚的蛇蜥,跑行的鯊魚,爬樹的螃蟹等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少地方比索諾蘭沙漠更美麗,更嚴峻.探索風吹沙,高聳的火山峰,並深入外星般的隕石坑.於這個被遺忘的荒野中,缺水的動植物只有適應或者死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit the Monteverde cloud forest, where swirling mists feed Costa Ricas mighty rivers and create a haven for biodiversity. See some of its 750 tree species, hang out with sloths and monkeys, and watch nature heal after decades of deforestation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證無尾熊瑪拉進行攸關性命的牙科手術,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起評估受傷的滑翔鼠.與獸醫艾麗斯一起從排水溝中救出一隻狐蝠,並看看護士布里孵化的一窩蟒蛇蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Brees clutch of python eggs hatch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於泰國的湄公河沿岸是溫帶與熱帶的交界;跟隨攝製隊沿着河流穿越金三角,欣賞該區眾多鳥類的求偶舞,再一同參與水靈祭典.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekongs banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the regions abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vision – its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 甲蟲已經在地球上居住了超過2.4億年.科學家們已知的甲蟲大約有38萬種,而每年都會發現數百種新品種.世上四分之一的動物是甲蟲.牠們幾乎征服了地球上每個角落和棲息地,在每次全球災難中都能倖存下來.牠們為何如此成功?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquer...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣.看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物.瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive under Mexicos Yucatán rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞拉利昂戈達位於墨西哥中部的中心地帶,是一個由許多生態組成的地區.從海拔300至3000米拔地而起,從古老的半沙漠化低山開始,進入一片茂密的綠色雲霧森林,當中棲息著山貓,美洲獅和飛鼠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物.一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引.但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈.莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the worlds largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defe...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇.深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊.但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界.雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要.在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力.有時生存只能依靠超能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同欣賞四季更迭,並深入了解樹木和動物如何相互依賴共生.在夜幕低垂之際,欣賞在春天夜晚翩翩起舞的螢火蟲,探索協助樹木降溫的夏季菌菇,並在秋葉紛飛之際為秋季的來臨做好準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.
